record.body:
## Problem

Needs-you items stay visible after the human has already answered in chat, because skills open continuity-questions, needs:human findings, and unsigned manual checks but almost never clear them; only plan-review is answered on approval. The dashboard correctly mirrors open records, so the user has to tell an agent to close them by hand.

## Approach

Mixture of skill close rules and dashboard dismiss, same clear model (engage-remind, dismiss-human-gates, dashboard-cli-writes):

1. Document human-dismissible kinds and clear commands in kinds-and-focus; teach engage to remind without gating; document clears in skills that open those gates.
2. Add dashboard dismiss for those kinds only, via adaptive-artifacts CLI; refuse merge/integration/loop-route; show errors and keep the item on CLI failure.
3. Verify with skill-contract/documentation tests and dashboard pilot tests through the live UI entry point.

Session shape: one sitting. Human stops: plan review; optional live dismiss smoke on a real store after merge. Parallel tasks share the human-dismissible kind set from the design — do not invent a second vocabulary. Wave 1 is skill docs and dashboard dismiss (no shared files); wave 2 is verification.

## Exit criteria

Skills close or clear human-dismissible Needs-you sources when the user answers them in an agent session; engage reminds without gating; the dashboard dismisses those kinds via CLI and refuses non-human kinds; skill-contract consistency and dashboard dismiss pilot tests pass (`uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_skill_contract_consistency.py tests/test_discuss_skill.py tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k 'needs_you or dismiss or engage or clear'` scoped to this phase's new tests, plus the contract consistency suite).

## Landing

- branch: phase/needs-you-close
- worktree: /home/andrewyin/se-workflow--needs-you-close
- base: main
- close: commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into main; commit the store on the primary checkout
